description: Realistic 2-3 minute VC pitch transcript (~400 words, ~140 WPM) covering all expected beats with natural fillers and pauses
transcript: Good morning everyone, thank you for having me. I'm Alex Rivera, co-founder and CEO of FleetMind. So let me paint a picture for you. Right now, there are over 4 million commercial delivery trucks on US roads, and fleet managers are basically flying blind. They're using spreadsheets and phone calls to coordinate routes, monitor fuel costs, and track driver safety. The result? An average fleet wastes 23% of its fuel budget on inefficient routing alone. That's roughly $18,000 per truck per year just, um, literally going up in smoke. We built FleetMind to fix this. FleetMind is an AI-powered fleet intelligence platform that sits on top of existing telematics hardware — no new sensors needed — and provides real-time route optimization, predictive maintenance alerts, and driver coaching. Think of it like having a brilliant operations manager who never sleeps, watching every truck 24/7. Now, why is this the right moment? Two things happened in the last 18 months. First, the DOT mandated electronic logging devices in all commercial vehicles, which means every truck now generates data — but nobody is using it effectively. Second, diesel prices hit a ten-year high, so fleet operators are desperate to cut costs. The timing couldn't be better. So here's where it gets exciting. We launched our pilot 9 months ago with 3 regional carriers. Today we have 41 paying customers managing over 6,000 trucks on our platform. Our ARR just crossed $1.8 million, and we're growing at 30% month over month. Net revenue retention is 140% because customers keep adding more trucks. Our churn is essentially zero — we haven't lost a single customer since launch. The US fleet management software market is $8.6 billion and, you know, projected to grow at 15% CAGR through 2030. But we see the real opportunity in the mid-market segment — fleets with 50 to 500 trucks — which is massively underserved by the enterprise incumbents like Samsara and Geotab. That's a $2.3 billion addressable market with no dominant player. Our unit economics are strong. Average contract value is $44K annually with a 14-month payback period and 82% gross margins. We're raising a $12 million Series A to, uh, triple our engineering team, expand our sales org into the Southeast and Midwest, and launch our predictive maintenance module which customers have been asking for since day one. We believe FleetMind can become the operating system for commercial fleets. Thank you.
